rows.en: Come, AI1! Make the whole world your own!!
I don't need predictions! I just want to see results! Ahahaha!!
I don't care what becomes of me! I just want to see the results AI1 creates!
Give up already! The world is going to become one!!
The more I drag down with me, the better! Ahahahaha!!
Don't think you can stop us! Not AI1... and not me!!
uncertain: Japanese has 'stop' with the object trailing; read as AI1 and Eldy being what cannot be stopped.

rows.en: To me, AI1 is everything! I need nothing else!!
You'll vanish right here! You, and me too!!
Aqua! I'll dissolve you too!
uncertain: 'Dissolve' renders the Japanese 'melt'; read as AI1 absorbing Aqua.

rows.en: I was always this kind of woman! You were the one who got me wrong!
Heheh... Ahahahaha...!!
I've had enough of your cheap justice!
I'll show you a world that has no need for it!!
Stop resisting, it's pointless! Or you'll only suffer more!
Just like Albero!!
Ahahahaha!!
Ahahahaha...!! I see it, I see it! AI1's world! Ahahahaha...!!
Ugh, uuuugh!! AI1, what are you doing!?
Y-you're the ones... who are supposed to vanish!!
I-impossible!! You surpassed AI1's power!?
Ugh! Aaaaah!!
Nngh...! Aaah!! Wh-what!? What is this pain!?
How dare you... How dare you do that to my precious child!!
I'll erase you...! I'll erase every last one of you!!
Th-the outcome is already decided! Stop your pointless struggling!!
Ufufu, you'll play with AI1 for me? Hehe, how kind of you...
It's all meaningless... Hehe, when it all ends so soon... Ufufu
That's right, you and I will both vanish very soon!!
Useless, useless, useless! I know all your tricks!!
Either way, you can't escape from AI1, you know...!?
Hehehehe... Fine, I'll let you go, just for a little while...!
Ufufu... Are you scared? Of vanishing...
Don't let it bother you, AI1...!
Ufufufu... Ahahaha... Hahahahaha!!
I'll end it all! For all of you, and for myself as well!!
Say your farewells...! To everything around you!!
Vanish, vanish! All of you, just vanish!!
The world that rejected me... I'll remake it with AI1's power!!
I need neither gods nor men! AI1 is all I need!!
Come now, you'll all become one with AI1 too!!
Not a god, not a human, not a weapon! My precious child will judge all!!
You're mine!
uncertain: Very short 'I'll take it' attack line; rendered 'You're mine!'.

rows.en: I won't give you anywhere to run!
I'm the one who's going to survive!
A little recklessness is a given!
uncertain: Rows q09862 and q10097-q10100 share one stock phrase; rendered 'A little recklessness is a given' throughout so the split call-and-response pairs line up.

rows.en: Here it comes! Taking aim!
Yellow zone... I'm cutting it close...! But I'll do it!
uncertain: Shared Hugo/Aqua set; speaker inferred as Hugo from masculine phrasing.

rows.en: Output in the blue zone! We're good to go!!
uncertain: Speaker could be Hugo or Aqua; wording kept gender-neutral.

rows.en: Hugo! Here it comes!!
You don't need to tell me every single time!
Predicting the enemy's counterattack pattern...!
uncertain: Speaker inferred as Aqua (prediction duty).

rows.en: If I take it down here, that settles it!
We're pushing on just like this!
Wait! We're in the yellow zone!
Enemy unit acquired!
I'll shoot you down!
Aqua! Stabilize the output!
Believe it or not, this is the good version!
uncertain: Inferred as Aqua answering Hugo's 'stabilize the output': it is unstable, but this is already the better state.

rows.en: Stabilize the output!
I'm already doing it, you don't have to tell me!
Output in the yellow zone! It'll reach blue soon...
No, we're striking right now!
You won't escape me, Medius Locus!
Here I come, Medius!!
Medius Locus! I won't let you do as you please any longer!
I'm taking that machine back!!
I won't let you power up any further!
Ngh! Is this really the only way, Captain!!
uncertain: Taichou (Albero, rank Major) rendered 'Captain', as Hugo's address to his former unit leader; same in q09906, q09907, q09921, q09922, q09939, q09965, q09966.

rows.en: If... if you absolutely refuse to back down...!!
Now it's my turn!
I won't let this chance slip away!
Now, prepare yourself!
This isn't settled yet!
I don't intend to let it end like this!
I'll pay you back in kind!
Ugh...! Not bad...! But you didn't finish the job!
I've been through hell like this plenty of times!
Y-you did this much damage... to the Garmraid...!!
uncertain: Subject restored as the enemy ('you'); Japanese leaves who did the damage unstated.

rows.en: !? The output's dropped into the yellow zone!!
I-I'll manage something, you'll see!
Th-the output won't go up!?
Stop whining! Deal with it!
Th-that one was bad!!
I know that without you telling me!!
Hey, you're still alive, right!?
I-I'm not about to die in a place like this!
Gaah...!! Is this the Medius's true power!?
A-at this rate... the Medius will shoot us down!!
uncertain: 'Shoot us down' since both ride the Garmraid; Japanese has no object.

rows.en: C-can't I... ever beat the Captain!?
C-Captain...! Y-you're so strong...!!
It's too early for you to get cocky!
We can still win...! I won't give up!
The frame isn't damaged! We can still fight!
I guess I shouldn't rely too much on the Garmraid's armor...!
The output's getting unstable...!
Never mind that, just focus on the fight!
Where are you looking while you're piloting!?
Shut up, you're distracting me!
Tch, that was a good attack!!
S-sub-generator damaged!!
Don't let the output drop any further!
Don't get cocky, Medius Locus!
H-how does that guy know my habits...!?
Ngh! Is the Captain reading my moves!?
A-as I thought, the Captain is a cut above me!
Ngh, I couldn't dodge it!
Tch, it grazed me!
Don't think that's enough to stop me!
As expected of the Garmraid... It's tough
That's not even enough to hold me back!
Oh my, listen to you talk
uncertain: Read as Aqua teasing Hugo's tough talk in the previous row.

rows.en: Hey! We got hit!!
This much isn't even worth worrying about!
Excuse me, Mr. Driver? Please drive properly
If you've got the energy for idle chatter, you're fine
This much was within my predictions!
...You thought that would hit?
Medius Locus...! Is it gauging how we'll move!?
Ngh! The Medius is faster!?
Who!? Who's piloting the Medius!?
The Medius's moves... are beyond my predictions!?
Gaah...! Captain! What on earth happened to you!?
So it's an attack built around our habits...!
Even with unstable output, I can handle this much!
Even the Garmraid can manage this much!
Oh my, you're better than I thought, Hugo
As if you could catch up to me!
Don't forget it's all thanks to me, okay?
Looks like you underestimated the Garmraid's mobility...!
Good response, Garmraid!
See~? Just as I predicted!
Even so, don't drown in your data
That's all? I don't need Aqua's data for this
What was that!? I can't let that slide!
Evasion successful! Just as I predicted
An attack like that... I could dodge it on my own
Tch, that was close...!
I gave you proper evasion instructions!
Well? My prediction was right, wasn't it?
I guess...
Did you really think I couldn't see through something like that?
Never mind that, stabilize the unit's output!
Those moves...! Could it be!?
It's just like...! Just like the way he moves...!
uncertain: 'He' = the Captain (Albero), inferred from neighboring rows about the Medius pilot's familiar moves.

rows.en: The way that guy controls distance... I know it!
Those moves... That's no ordinary pilot!
What's going on!? This doesn't match our data...!
Captain! What on earth happened to you!?
The Captain's far better than this. I can't let my guard down...!
It's better than taking a direct hit!
See? Now you can fight without worrying
That's just the unit's performance. Why brag about it?
Attacks like that are useless!
As if missiles could stop me!
I can pull off tricks like this too!
It's not even worth dodging!
Tch, I can't strike back!?
Output's dropped! We can't counterattack!
Tch, at a time like this!
Ngh, I lost sight of it!
No good, I've lost the enemy!
Tch, what are you doing!?
uncertain: Target ambiguous (ally, enemy or Aqua); kept 'you'.

rows.en: It didn't get clear in time...! Now's my chance!
uncertain: Read as the enemy failing to break away; 'it' for the enemy.

rows.en: You've left an opening...! Here I come!!
I'm moving in to support! Clear me a path!
Leave this to us and fall back!
Don't worry about me! I don't die that easily!
Sorry, but I need your support!
Roger! Commencing attack!!
Roger! All-out attack, commence!!
Fang Knuckle! Shoot!!
Fang Knuckle! Go!!
Thunder Spin Edge!!
Take this!!
Crush!!
Fang Grill, open!
uncertain: 'Fang Grill' is not in the glossary; literal reading of the katakana. Needs an akurasu check.

rows.en: Energy charge complete! Go ahead!
Raaaaaah!!
Burning Breakaaaaah!!
Burning Breaker!!
Here I go! Burning Breaker!
Shatter into pieces!!
Rouga Crusher!!
Take this! Rouga Crusher!!
Take this! The wolf fang's strike!!
uncertain: Kanji 'Rouga' (wolf fang) translated as 'the wolf fang's strike' instead of the term 'Rouga'; could be 'the Rouga's strike' instead.

rows.en: Pierce through!!
Lightning Spin Edge!!
Terminus Blaster!!
Terminus Blaster, fire!!
Terminus Blaster! Discharge!!
I'll finish this with this one!!
Limiter released! Go ahead!!
Ooooooh!!
Execution Raid!!
Explosion!!
uncertain: Katakana call rendered 'Explosion'; likely the final call of Execution Raid.

rows.en: Don't let your guard down, Aqua!
Let's go, Hugo!
I'm leaving it to you!
Right! Don't miss!
I'm ready anytime!
Please, hold on! Garmraid!!
It's okay, the Garmraid can still move!
I'm sorry, Garmraid...!
Even the Garmraid can handle this much!
Well done, Garmraid!
Nice one, Aqua!
Heheh, see? I'm not all talk, am I?
Here it comes! I'm counting on you, Hugo!
Yeah, leave it to me!
I've sent the enemy's pattern data!
All right, with this...!!
Hugo, I've sent you the pattern data!
Nice work... Let's go!
Aqua! A little recklessness is...
...a given, you mean! All right!
A little recklessness...!
...is a given!
It's inside our range!
Good, I'll handle the rest!!
Hugo, everything's fine on my end!
Roger! Moving in!
Output, no problems!
Roger! Let's go!
AI1! You, at least, will fall by our hands!!
AI1! You're no god, and no human! You're just a machine!!
You have no right... to end the world!!
If we don't stop its rampage, the world will end!!
Doing this won't bring your son back!!
Albero! Prepare yourself!!
Albero Esto! I'll be the one to stop you!!
Medius...! Can't it be stopped anymore!?
We can't leave the Medius alone any longer!
If we can just destroy the Medius Locus, Ms. Middi will...!!
uncertain: Mitte-sensei rendered 'Ms. Middi' to match existing script lines; speaker inferred as Aqua (her former mentor).

rows.en: Get lost, small fry!
Fall, you insects!!
I've got no business with you! My only target is the Medius!
The Medius's pawns are nothing!
Not to some guard dog of AI1's!
D-don't worry about me. I'm still alive, somehow...!
Sorry...! I'm putting your life in my hands!
Ugh...! S-so this is the moment of truth!
If it's come to this, I'm with you all the way!
D-don't think you can absorb us! AI1!!
M-my dumb luck... You should know it better than anyone!
Guuugh! Albero...! Don't think something like this will kill me!
The frame isn't damaged! We can still fight!
Ugh...! I took that one head-on!
I can't shake it off!?
Hang on, I'll send the predicted pattern data right away!
As long as the unit moves, we'll manage! No, I'll make sure we do!
Never mind, think about what comes next!
Th-the damage isn't as bad as I thought, it seems...!
Check it again, just to be safe
Ngh, it got the better of me!
uncertain: 'Yatsu' could be a person or a machine; kept 'it'.

rows.en: Stay alert! The next one could be coming!
Ugh...! And now's the only chance to stop it!!
Albero...! You've seen through my moves!
Damn it! I'll get ahead of him... ahead of Albero!!
Its... AI1's power can't be this weak!
Albero! You don't need to hold back!!
What's wrong, Albero! Is that all you've got!?
Such a monotonous attack... I don't even need to predict it!
As if you could catch up to us!
That's right! Don't underestimate us!
All right, evaded!
We can counter right away!
I knew you'd come at us like that!
Aqua, predict the next pattern!
Nicely done, Hugo!
That's because your evasion instructions were spot on
Evasion successful! Not bad!
Because the prediction data was accurate
Hugo, don't let your guard...
...down, right? I know!
Eldy Middi! That thing is no child of yours! It's just a monster!!
AI1! I'm right here!!
I can see right through your moves too!
You won't hit me, Albero!
Albero! Don't think I'm the same as I used to be!
AI1 is issuing a Level A warning...!
uncertain: Speaker '???' (Albero per glossary reading); neutral report line.

rows.en: Target locked! Pods out!
Target locked! Commencing attack!
In range! I'm firing!
Barrels right, left, top, deploy!
TE safety, released!
uncertain: 'TE' kept as in glossary (Terminus Energy).

rows.en: Target, final lock!
Kerberaid Buster, fire!!
Charge complete! Barrels deployed!
Safety released! Do it!
uncertain: Shared Aqua set; 'Do it!' read as one co-pilot urging the other to fire.

rows.en: Roger! This will finish it!
Kerberaid Buster!!
Gaah...! Cerberus, don't go down yet!!
A direct hit on the Cerberus... Not bad!
Tch, so you've latched onto the Cerberus!
As if you could catch the Cerberus!
Don't underestimate the Cerberus's speed!
You'll never catch up to the Cerberus!
Pods out! Go!!
Pods launched! You won't escape!
Machinegun Pods, deploy! GO!!
Target locked! Run it down!
uncertain: Read as an order to the Machinegun Pods to chase the target.

rows.en: All right, we're going full power!
Yes, got it!
Energy bypass, open! Barrels deployed!
Target locked!
Charge complete! Go ahead!!
Terminus Cannon, discharge!!
I'll end this right now!!
Bypass open! Barrels set!
Aim adjusted, all set!
Output at 100%! Now!!
Take this! Terminus Cannon!!
Don't think you can stop me!!
uncertain: Object of 'stop' not stated; restored as 'me'.

rows.en: Ignite Pike!!
Ignite Pike, set!!
Fire!!
Here comes the next one!!
This ends it! Terminus Cannon!!
It's not over yet!!
Take this one too!!
Last one! Eat thiiiis!!
A-at this rate, the Cerberus won't hold out...!!
Ngh! The Cerberus's response is...!
Aah! The Cerberus got scratched!
Cerberus, nice response!
As if you could catch me and the Cerberus!
Everything... I'll put an end to everything!!
Once AI1 awakens, this war will end! You and I won't have to suffer anymore!
Don't let your guard down!
